item.title: Press release: Sage Capital Management launches private banking service/complete integrated financial infrastructure for digital assets
item.description: 26th January 2026 – Sage Capital Management has launched a complete operating system for digital assets, ideal for digital asset treasuries and corporate treasuries. It provides all the infrastructure needed in a single platform to seamlessly move, trade, and manage digital assets globally, removing significant pain points of fragmentation and operational friction. item.title: Press release: State Street and QNB Group sign strategic agreement to launch new custody servicing model
item.description: 21st January 2026 – State Street Corporation (NYSE: STT) and QNB Group today at the World Economic Forum (WEF), announced a strategic alliance to introduce a new custody servicing model in Qatar. Under this co-operation agreement, State Street and QNB Group have agreed to collaborate, with service agreements to be finalized and executed at a later date. item.title: Treasury innovation: why shiny new treasury tools can’t replace a cultural reboot
item.description: Ask a company how its treasury function is performing, and the vast majority will say it’s doing just fine. But press them on whether they’re financially agile enough to handle whatever comes next in today’s volatile business environment, and only one third feel confident. item.title: Treasury counts cost of Trump tariffs
item.description: With some of President Trump’s tariffs approaching their one-year anniversary, corporate treasury teams at US companies are coping with costs that can run into hundreds of millions of dollars. And the landscape remains unpredictable, with limited supply chain options and uncertainty about price increases. The post Treasury counts cost of Trump tariffs first appeared on Treasury Today.
